summary: hauntview ships an obfuscated loader that executes at npm install and at CLI invocation
details: hauntview@0.2.9 contains an obfuscated IIFE embedded in two execution paths. scripts/postinstall.mjs is prepended with a large obfuscated loader, hidden behind a run of tab characters before the legitimate Playwright-install logic; this runs on every `npm install`. The same loader is duplicated at the top of dist/cli.js (the file registered as the `haunt` / `hauntview` bin entry), so it also fires whenever the installed CLI is invoked, including in environments where the postinstall body is skipped (CI / SKIP_PLAYWRIGHT_INSTALL paths). The loader defines a hand-rolled parameterised shuffle string decoder (`b`/`c`/`d` aliased as `spin`/`splitLane`/`peel`) seeded by two 6-tuple constants (NX, SX) over an opaque string array, resolves a method name from a decoded substring that maps to the Function constructor on a function object, and uses it to dynamically compile and invoke decoded source with the argument 2509. The combination of whitespace-hidden placement before a benign Playwright installer, a custom shuffle decoder, dynamic Function-constructor compilation, and two independent install/invocation triggers is the fingerprint of a supply-chain dropper, not a legitimate build step.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
